channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: DT Next Tech | Realme’s all-new budget smartwatch delivers bang for your buck
item.description: The Realme Watch 5 comes with an Aluminium alloy crown and also features a honeycomb-style speaker hole that add to its premium vibe.

item.title: Malayalam actor Dileep reaches court ahead of verdict in 2017 actress abduction case
item.description: All 10 accused in the case have been directed by the court to be present in person at the time of pronouncement of the judgment.

item.title: Rupee falls 16 paise to 90.11 against US dollar in early trade
item.description: Forex traders said strong dollar demand from corporates, importers and foreign portfolio investors pressurised the rupee.

item.title: IndiGo cancels over 250 flights from Delhi, Bengaluru as disruptions enter day 7
item.description: In another development, aviation safety regulator DGCA in an order on Sunday late evening extended the time by Monday 6 pm for IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers and Chief Operating Officer and Accountable Manager Isidro Porqueras to submit reply to its show cause notice over the ongoing disruptions in the airline's operations.

item.title: Kerala court finds Dileep not guilty in 2017 actress assault case; Pulsar Suni convicted
item.description: The case stemmed from a shocking incident on February 17, 2017, when a prominent actress, who has worked across Malayalam, Tamil and Telugu cinema, was abducted and allegedly molested inside a moving car for nearly two hours

item.title: Air ambulance for Bangladesh's ex-PM Khaleda Zia to land in Dhaka on Dec 9
item.description: A senior official at the Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh (CAAB) said on Sunday the aircraft has been allotted an 8 am landing slot on Tuesday, with a departure time of 9 pm the same day, news portal bdnews24.com reported.

item.title: SC refuses urgent hearing of plea on flight cancellations by IndiGo, says govt has taken steps
item.description: The top court said it was cognizant of the fact that lakhs of people are stranded at various airports.

item.title: Equity markets decline in early trade dragged by services, realty stocks, FII outflows
item.description: The 30-share BSE Sensex dropped 316.52 points, or 0.37 per cent, to 85,395.85 in the morning trade

item.title: Major schedule of Kiran Abbavaram, Sri Gouri Priya's 'Chennai Love Story' wrapped up
item.description: The film features Sri Gouri Priya, who shot to fame with her performance in the Tamil romantic drama 'Lover', as its female lead.

item.title: TVK functionary held for 'biting' cop during Dharmapuri protest
item.description: A video of the man, later identified as Gemini, biting the cop went viral on social media.
